properties.name: canonical-log.resilience4j.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Resilience4j canonical-log contributor is auto-configured (attaching to every Retry, CircuitBreaker, Bulkhead, ThreadPoolBulkhead, RateLimiter and TimeLimiter registry bean in the context, including instances those registries create later). Active when absent (matchIfMissing); set false to disable.
